rows.text: Dear Nameless! Welcome to the Party Car, drinksmith robot Shush at your service! Would you like something to eat or drink before chatting with me about the interesting things that happened during the trip?
rows.speaker: "Shush"

rows.text: Your trust in my skills moves me!
rows.speaker: "Shush"

rows.text: I would like to chat with you.
You taking time from your busy schedule to chat truly touches me!
rows.speaker: "Shush"

rows.text: I've decided to upgrade your Party Car membership level to the highest tier! You might ask, "What are the benefits to the membership tier?"
rows.speaker: "Shush"

rows.text: The answer is of course: Nothing!
rows.speaker: "Shush"
